title: Add Code Snippet
content: Create code snippet component. Container: relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden. Header: flex justify-between px-4 py-2 bg-gray-800, language label (text-sm text-gray-400), copy button. Code area: bg-gray-900 p-4 overflow-x-auto. Pre/code: text-sm font-mono text-gray-100, syntax highlighting via PrismJS or highlight.js. Copy button: hover:bg-gray-700 p-1 rounded, shows "Copied!" tooltip on success. Line numbers: optional, text-gray-500 select-none pr-4.

variants.simple: Create syntax-highlighted code block with copy button.
variants.detailed: Create code snippet component. Container: relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden. Header: flex justify-between px-4 py-2 bg-gray-800, language label (text-sm text-gray-400), copy button. Code area: bg-gray-900 p-4 overflow-x-auto. Pre/code: text-sm font-mono text-gray-100, syntax highlighting via PrismJS or highlight.js. Copy button: hover:bg-gray-700 p-1 rounded, shows "Copied!" tooltip on success. Line numbers: optional, text-gray-500 select-none pr-4.
variants.advanced: Create full-featured code snippet component. Syntax highlighting: PrismJS/Shiki/highlight.js with multiple theme options (dark, light, specific like Dracula, One Dark). Language support: detect language or accept prop, display language badge. Header: filename if provided, language badge, action buttons. Line numbers: optional, sticky when scrolling horizontally, clickable to select line. Line highlighting: highlight specific lines (e.g., lines 3-5), different styles for added/removed (diff mode). Copy button: copies code without line numbers, visual feedback (icon change, tooltip), copy successful notification. Word wrap toggle: button to toggle wrapping vs horizontal scroll. Expand/collapse: for long snippets, show first N lines with "Show more" button. Diff mode: side-by-side or inline diff view, color-coded additions (green) and deletions (red). Live editing: optional editable mode with onChange callback. Run button: optional for runnable snippets (JS playground). Tab size: 2 or 4 spaces toggle. Max height: scrollable with fade gradient at bottom indicating more content. Accessibility: proper code semantics, copy button accessible, not using only color for highlighting.
